initial_findings.title: A structurally accepted empty draft crashes the editor
initial_findings.expected_fix: Reject or safely repair snapshots that cannot produce a valid active page.

initial_findings.title: Autosave loses music and persists non-restorable blob URLs
initial_findings.expected_fix: Persist a complete, restorable document without durable blob URLs and close every object-URL lifecycle.

initial_findings.title: Preview is not document-faithful and fixed device frames clip on small screens
initial_findings.expected_fix: Use a faithful read-only renderer and make all preview device modes fit the available viewport.

initial_findings.title: The real export path is unverified and diverges from the live canvas
initial_findings.expected_fix: Make exported files reproduce the visible card and validate a successful browser export.

initial_findings.title: The native share branch sends an unpublished fake URL through a real share sheet
initial_findings.expected_fix: Do not invoke real external sharing with an unpublished URL; preserve an explicit simulation boundary.

initial_findings.title: Template replacement omits the prototype’s preserve-content path
initial_findings.expected_fix: Implement the prototype’s preserve-content choice alongside full replacement and cancel.

initial_findings.title: The implementation leaves two incompatible canonical editor models
initial_findings.expected_fix: Establish one canonical document contract or an explicit tested adapter boundary.

initial_findings.title: Required UI fidelity and deterministic skill evidence is absent
initial_findings.expected_fix: Publish reproducible UI comparisons and all required deterministic implementation-skill checks.

initial_findings.title: Page selection and no-op actions create undo entries
initial_findings.expected_fix: Only document mutations should append history; UI navigation and no-ops should not.

initial_findings.title: Global Escape bypasses the typing guard
initial_findings.expected_fix: Apply Escape deselection only outside form/editing contexts unless explicitly delegated.

initial_findings.title: Interrupted pointer gestures are not finalized
initial_findings.expected_fix: Finalize gesture state on pointerup, pointercancel, and lost pointer capture.
